narrative.overview: CirrhoSmart AI Android translates hospital hepatology risk prediction and deterministic drug safety checks into a high-contrast Material Design 3 bedside utility. Every screen separates Operate mode (mortality prediction, length-of-stay stratification, and renal/hepatic dose evaluation) from Read mode (research methodology, 4-step user guide, and 44 cited references), prioritizing unambiguous numeric alignment, fast thumb reachability during ward rounds, and zero ambiguity under fluorescent ward glare or night-shift lighting.
keyCharacteristics: Native Android Material Design 3 architecture built with custom React Native primitives and responsive Window Size Class tokens (compact, medium, expanded).
First-class Light and Dark schemes maintaining WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1) contrast across every clinical status banner and input label.
Strict tabular-nums alignment across all laboratory parameters, AUROC scores, SHAP divergence bars, UNOS MELD badges, and dosing bounds.
Minimum 48 dp touch targets separated by at least 8 dp gaps on every interactive control.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Discipline Rule
rules.body: Never spend emerald, amber, or red hues as decorative card chrome—clinical color bands are strictly bound to risk stratification, drug safety classification, or inline error/success feedback.

rules.name: The Tabular Precision Rule
rules.body: Every predicted probability, MELD score, eGFR value, MAP calculation, INR readout, cohort statistic, and dosing bound MUST use one of the four numeric* typography roles (fontVariant: ['tabular-nums']).

rules.name: The Measured Separation Rule
rules.body: Related inputs inside a ClinicalCard group at 12dp–16dp gaps, while distinct clinical sections and headings maintain greater breathing room above (24dp) than below (4dp–8dp).

rules.name: The Flat-Tonal Discipline Rule
rules.body: Convey hierarchy via luminance contrast between canvas and surface containers plus hairline 1dp borders—never invent decorative box shadows or thick left-edge accent stripes (border-left > 1dp).

dos: Do enforce minimum 48x48 dp hit targets (TOUCH_TARGET.MIN_SIZE_DP) and >= 8 dp spacing (TOUCH_TARGET.MIN_GAP_DP) on every touchable element.
Do test and maintain both Light (#F8FAFC) and Dark (#111318) color schemes with WCAG AA contrast (>= 4.5:1) using colors.* semantic tokens exclusively.
Do normalize comma decimals via parseLocaleNumber() before client validation and API payload serialization, and apply UNOS 1.0 floor / 4.0 mg/dL creatinine cap on hitungMeldUnos().
Do support Android system Reduce Motion (MOTION.REDUCED_MS = 0) across animated modals and transitions while keeping active motion crisp (150-250ms).
Do preserve keyboard & portrait/landscape responsiveness (softwareKeyboardLayoutMode: resize, orientation: default).
donts: Don't hardcode raw hex color strings inside component TSX files or bypass ThemeProvider tokens.
Don't render wide horizontal data tables with multi-column clipping on phones (< 600 dp)—switch cleanly to stacked key-value strips on compact screens.
Don't clear user inputs, close modals, or emit generic pop-up alert() calls on validation errors or 401 authorization failures—render inline InlineAlert feedback in place.
Don't mix Cupertino UI widgets, browser <select> metaphors, emojis, or decorative eyebrows/kickers above headings into Material 3 surfaces.
Don't perform local mock predictions or override server dosing rules; display server responses faithfully with explicit mandatory clinical review disclaimers.
